# Honest Little Apps — free calendars and web stories

> Free subscribable iPhone/Google/Outlook calendars and short visual guides from Honest Little Apps, a small iPhone app studio. Each calendar is paired with one of the studio's free apps.

## Calendars

- [Proverbs a Day: the reading calendar for men](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/proverbs-a-day-for-men/): Read one chapter of Proverbs each day of the month, with a short note and a practical challenge for men. Free calendar for iPhone, Mac and Google. Related app: FORGED: Daily Bible for Men.
- [Psalms in a Month: five psalms a day, matched to the date](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/psalms-in-a-month/): Read all 150 Psalms every month: five a day, matched to the date, with a real-life moment for each day. Free calendar for iPhone, Mac and Google. Related app: Lampstep: Bible for Real Life.
- [The New Testament in 2027: one chapter every weekday](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/new-testament-in-a-year-2027/): Read all 260 New Testament chapters in 2027, one chapter per weekday, weekends free. Book introductions and a study question each day. Free iPhone calendar. Related app: Wayfold: Understand the Bible.
- [Fruit of the Spirit: one fruit a week, all year](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/fruit-of-the-spirit-weekly/): A free weekly calendar that walks through the nine fruits of the Spirit (Galatians 5:22-23), one per week, with a key verse and three practical steps. Related app: Ninefruit: Fruit of the Spirit.
- [Bible trivia: one question a day, answer included](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/bible-trivia-question-of-the-day/): One Bible trivia question each day of the month, with the answer and verse reference. Great for families, kids and small groups. Free calendar for iPhone. Related app: Scrollway: Bible Study Game.
- [A water reminder that lives in your calendar](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/water-reminder-calendar/): Free subscribable calendar with three gentle water check-ins a day (10am, 1pm, 4pm) and a short, evidence-based hydration tip in each. Works in Apple Calendar. Related app: Dropkin: Water Reminder.
- [Keep your muscle on GLP-1: a 3-day strength calendar](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/strength-training-calendar-glp1/): A free calendar with three 25-minute home strength sessions a week plus a Sunday protein check, built for adults losing weight on GLP-1 or other medication. Related app: Sturdy: Strength on GLP-1.
- [Perimenopause and menopause check-ins, on your calendar](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/menopause-symptom-check-in-calendar/): Free perimenopause and menopause calendar: a 2-minute weekly symptom log, a monthly check-in list and an appointment-prep reminder. Private; nothing to sign up for. Related app: My Midlife Story: Menopause.
- [Medication housekeeping, on autopilot](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/medication-refill-reminder-calendar/): Free calendar for medication housekeeping: monthly refill check, quarterly caregiver list update, twice-yearly cabinet clear-out and an annual pharmacist review. Related app: DoseBeacon: Pill Reminder.
- [Quit vaping in January: a 30-day calendar plan](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/quit-vaping-30-day-calendar-2027/): A free 30-day quit vaping plan that runs January 1-30, 2027: prep days, quit day, craving tactics and daily check-ins delivered to your iPhone calendar. Related app: CraveBreaker: Quit Vaping.
- [Health awareness days, with one good fact each](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/health-awareness-days-calendar/): Free calendar of 18 global health awareness days (World Health Day, World Heart Day, World Diabetes Day and more), each with a short, sourced fact. Repeats every year. Related app: Body Unpacked: Health Atlas.
- [A bedtime that actually starts at bedtime](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/bedtime-wind-down-reminder-calendar/): A free nightly 9:45pm wind-down reminder in your local time, plus 2027 daylight-saving clock-change alerts for the US, Canada, UK and EU. Subscribe in one tap. Related app: Sleepward: Bedtime Routine.
- [One phone-free hour a night, already scheduled](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/phone-free-hour-calendar/): A free calendar that blocks out 9-10pm every night as a phone-free hour, with a different practical idea each evening and a Sunday app check. Subscribe in one tap. Related app: FocusPass: App Blocker.
- [The 5-minute Sunday screen-time review](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/weekly-screen-time-review-calendar/): A free Sunday-evening calendar prompt to review your iPhone Screen Time report, with a rotating question and a monthly screen-time budget reset. Related app: Time Debt: Screen Time.
- [Start one thing at 9:30: a weekday nudge for hard starts](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/adhd-task-start-calendar/): A free weekday 9:30am calendar nudge to start one task for 10 minutes, with a different task-initiation tactic each day. Built for people who find starting hard. Related app: Now: ADHD Task Starter.
- [Measure your focus weekly, then experiment](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/weekly-focus-check-calendar/): A free Saturday calendar slot for a 5-minute weekly focus check, plus a mid-month attention experiment to test what actually improves your concentration. Related app: Attention Age: Focus Test.
- [A 4-minute focus warm-up before your afternoon](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/daily-focus-warm-up-calendar/): A free daily 12:30pm calendar event with a different 4-minute focus and memory drill each day of the week. No app or equipment needed. Related app: SkillArena: Focus Training.
- [A brain puzzle every day, answer tucked underneath](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/brain-puzzle-of-the-day-calendar/): A free calendar with one logic puzzle, riddle or number sequence each day of the month, answer included below. A quick daily brain teaser for adults. Related app: Cognilo: Brain Training Games.
- [One calm number puzzle a day: hit the target](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/daily-number-puzzle-calendar/): A free calendar with one calm number puzzle per day: five numbers, one target, plus and minus only. Answer included. Repeats monthly; great for adults and teens. Related app: Number Puzzles: Sumbriska.
- [Find the one path that adds up](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/daily-path-puzzle-calendar/): A free daily path puzzle in your calendar: a 4×4 grid, move right or down, find the only route that adds to the target. Every puzzle has exactly one answer. Related app: Sumthread.
- [Make ten: three quick number-bond questions a day](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/make-ten-math-calendar-for-kids/): A free daily calendar of three quick 'make ten' number-bond questions for kids (ages 5-8): bonds to 10, bridging through ten, and subtracting to 10. Answers included. Related app: Number Beasts: Bond Lab.
- [A gravity fact every day of the month](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/gravity-fact-of-the-day-calendar/): A free daily calendar of 31 accurate gravity and space facts, from the Apollo 15 hammer-and-feather drop to gravitational waves. Great for curious kids and adults. Related app: Fluxo: Gravity Runner.
- [A weather fact every morning, from lightning to hail](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/weather-fact-of-the-day-calendar/): A free daily calendar of 31 accurate weather facts on lightning, hurricanes, tornadoes, hail and records, plus Atlantic hurricane season dates. For curious kids and adults. Related app: RushOrb: Storm Atlas.
- [A money fact a day: compounding, history and habits](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/money-fact-of-the-day-calendar/): A free calendar with one money fact per day of the month: compound interest, the Rule of 72, banknote history and budgeting basics. Fun for teens and adults. Related app: Cash Empire Clicker.
- [On this day in history, with a question to investigate](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/on-this-day-in-history-calendar/): A free yearly calendar of 37 famous anniversaries, from Magna Carta to the Moon landing, each with a 'history detective' question about the evidence. Great for classes. Related app: PastRush: History Detective.
- [Every full moon of 2027 and 2028, at the exact minute](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/full-moon-calendar-2027/): Free full moon calendar for 2027-2028 with exact peak times in your own time zone, traditional moon names (Wolf, Pink, Harvest...) and every equinox and solstice. Related app: Puffgrove: Grove Creatures.
- [2027 biweekly payday calendar, with a stub check](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/biweekly-payday-calendar-2027/): Free 2027 biweekly payday calendar for iPhone: every other Friday (two schedules), US federal holidays and a 2-minute pay stub check on each payday. Related app: EarnCheck: Shift & Pay Tracker.
- [The 10-minute monthly subscription audit](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/subscription-audit-calendar/): Free calendar reminder to audit your subscriptions on the 1st of every month, with iPhone steps, plus Black Friday free-trial and January annual-renewal checks. Related app: MoneyShield: Sub Tracker.
- [The 2027 calendar for independent contractors](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/contractor-tax-and-invoice-calendar-2027/): Free 2027 calendar for self-employed contractors: IRS quarterly estimated tax dates, the 1099-NEC deadline, a monthly unpaid-invoice chase and a Friday estimates reminder. Related app: ScopeBid: Estimate & Invoice.
- [2027 busy-season calendar for appointment businesses](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/appointment-business-busy-season-calendar-2027/): Free 2027 calendar for salons, barbers, photographers and other booked businesses: peak dates with 'open bookings' reminders 3 weeks ahead, plus Monday confirmations. Related app: BookingSolved: Client Booking.
- [Get your family ready, 15 minutes a month](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/family-emergency-preparedness-calendar/): A free family emergency preparedness calendar: one 15-minute task each month (go-bag, water, documents, fire drill), a monthly smoke-alarm test and clock-change battery checks. Related app: Family Ready: Emergency Plan.
- [The home maintenance calendar: three jobs a month](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/home-maintenance-calendar/): A free seasonal home maintenance calendar: three jobs on the first Saturday of every month (filters, gutters, GFCI tests, dryer vents, safety checks). Subscribe in one tap. Related app: RoomMend: Safer Home Plans.
- [A 2-minute math and reading warm-up for breakfast](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/kids-daily-math-reading-warm-up-calendar/): A free daily breakfast warm-up for kids: quick sums for little ones, harder sums and times tables for bigger kids, plus a rhyming word game. Answers included. Related app: Brainy Bucks: Math & Reading.
- [The 15-minute Sunday check-in for couples](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/weekly-couples-check-in-calendar/): A free 15-minute Sunday couples check-in calendar with a different question each week (13 rotating questions) and a simple listen-first format. Share it with your partner. Related app: UnFight: Couples & Marriage.
- [A date night idea on the first Friday of every month](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/monthly-date-night-ideas-calendar/): A free calendar with one seasonal date night idea on the first Friday of every month, plus a Valentine's booking reminder. Plan better dates without the guesswork. Related app: SecondYes: Second Date Planner.
- [A journal prompt in your calendar every morning](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/daily-journal-prompts-calendar/): A free calendar with one journaling prompt for each day of the month, including letters to your future self. Five minutes a day; repeats monthly. Related app: Dear You: Daily Letters.
- [Tonight's sunset and golden hour, in your calendar](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/calendars/sunset-golden-hour-calendar/): Free daily sunset and golden hour calendar for New York, LA, Chicago, Houston, Phoenix, Denver, Seattle, Miami, Toronto and London, through 2027. Exact times. Related app: Asterfold: Sunset Planner.

## iPad digital planners (hyperlinked PDF + stickers)
- [2027 Bible Reading Digital Planner](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/digital-planners/2027-bible-reading-digital-planner/): A hyperlinked iPad planner with the whole New Testament scheduled for 2027 (one chapter every weekday), a prayer list and notes pages.
- [2027 Water & Habit Digital Planner](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/digital-planners/2027-water-habit-digital-planner/): A hyperlinked iPad planner with a glass-by-glass water tracker for every day of 2027 and a 14-habit monthly tracker.
- [ADHD-Friendly Daily Digital Planner](https://honestlittleapps.github.io/digital-planners/adhd-daily-digital-planner/): An undated, hyperlinked iPad planner built around three priorities, a tiny first step, time blocks and a brain dump.
